issues.title: Headline typo: "preferrable"
issues.summary: The hero subhead reads "Personal, preferrable, AI-powered connections," using the misspelling "preferrable" instead of "preferable."
issues.recommended_action: Correct the hero copy to "preferable" and re-check the hero text for any adjacent copy edits before publishing.

issues.title: Section heading reads as a grammatical error
issues.summary: The integrations page includes the heading "Security share data," which reads as a broken phrase and does not match the surrounding clear, benefit-led headings.
issues.recommended_action: Replace the heading with the intended phrasing, such as "Securely share data," and verify the section title in the live page layout.

issues.title: Agenda section shows repeated stray time labels
issues.summary: The agenda block repeats the standalone time string "9:00 am – 10:15 am" before multiple agenda cards, which suggests a duplicated or leaking label that makes the schedule harder to scan.
issues.recommended_action: Remove the duplicate time labels from the agenda card pattern and confirm the schedule cards render once per session with a single time stamp.
